parsed.population_and_sample: Informal settlements (katchi abadis) in Karachi and other Pakistani cities (covering 334 katchi abadis and over 98,000 houses in Orangi).
parsed.exposure: Community-led mapping, the 'internal-external' sanitation development model, and technical/managerial support.
parsed.outcome: Improved sanitation (latrine and sewer connection), service access (water/sewerage), and changes in infrastructure planning and financing.
parsed.rationale: The study provides empirical evidence through mapping surveys and case study reporting of the Orangi Pilot Project's low-cost community-managed sanitation program in Karachi, Pakistan. It reports quantitative outcomes, such as the construction of sewerage systems in 5,479 lanes, investment figures, and improvements in health indicators, demonstrating the successful integration of community-built infrastructure into municipal planning (e.g., pp. 452, 458, 467-468).
